h1: Email parsing that captures orders and requests
overview: When orders, quote requests or booking details arrive as free-text emails, someone copies them out by hand. We connect to the inbox you choose, read each new message, pull out the details you care about and write them to a sheet, CRM or order tool. Emails that do not fit your rules stay in the inbox with a label so nothing is lost.

faq: Gmail, Google Workspace and Outlook or Microsoft 365 mailboxes work well. You add us as a collaborator or approve a connection in your own account, and you can revoke it whenever you want.
Can it read emails written in free text?
Yes, if the emails follow a loose pattern such as an order or request. Very short or mixed-topic emails are harder, so we test on your past emails and tell you what it can and cannot read.
Will it reply to customers on its own?
Only if you ask for it. The Premium package can send a plain confirmation. Anything beyond that, such as answering questions, is a different service and stays with your team.
Does it work with shared inboxes?
Yes, a shared support or orders inbox is a common use. We read only the folder or label you choose and leave everything else untouched.
